metadata.description: Claude Toolkit: Charter, Craft and TARS for Claude Code, plus a bundle that installs all three. Maintained by Mohammed.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Installs Charter, Craft and TARS together and wires them up in one pass. The one-command way in.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Improve existing SaaS interfaces without losing the product's identity. Preserve-first UI/UX evolution for Claude Code.

plugins.name: charter
plugins.description: A charter grants powers and limits them in the same document. Turns a two-minute interview into a project's working agreement and its enforced permission boundaries, then stays out of the way.

plugins.name: tars
plugins.description: A no-BS engineering partner output style. Answers first in a line or two, challenges weak reasoning, separates implemented from verified, and stays in scope.
